How it works

Three steps, and you do the first one only once.

1

Bring your orders in

Connect the shop, forward the order emails, or type in what the stall sold. Counter keeps one list.

2

Pack from the list

Orders stand in the order they must leave. Print the labels, fill the boxes, tick each one off.

3

Hand over to the courier

The pickup is already booked. Your customer gets a message when the courier sets off.

Questions farms ask first

The rest are answered in the help centre.

Do I need a web shop to use Counter?

No. Orders can come from a web shop, from forwarded emails, or be typed in at the market stall. Several farms run Counter with a phone and nothing else.

How long does setting up take?

About a morning. Add your products, connect where the orders come from, and print a test label. We answer questions on weekdays from 8:00 to 18:00.

What do I need to print labels?

Any printer. Labels come at 100 by 150 mm for a label printer, or four to a sheet of A4 for the printer you already have.

Can the people who pack use a phone?

Yes. The packing screen shows today's orders on a phone, with one tap to mark each one done. Everyone signs in under their own name, so you see who packed what.

Is there a contract?

No. Pay by the month or by the year and cancel at any time. After you cancel, the workspace stays open to read for 30 days.
